title: Decode search responses by actual ResultFormat, not by what you requested
answers: Why does list-with-selectors handle both ResourceTable and FIELD_VALUES rows?
How to safely change a search request's ResultFormat without breaking rolling deploys
Panic/nil decoding search response rows during upgrade
body: Symptom: a request changes ResourceSearchRequest.ResultFormat (e.g. table -> field values) but during a rolling upgrade some search backend replicas are still on old code and reply in the old format. Root cause: callers that assumed the response matches the requested format would get nil/wrong fields from the mismatched response shape. Fix pattern: decode based on response.GetResultFormat() itself (treating UNSPECIFIED as the legacy RESOURCE_TABLE default) and map both known formats into the same internal row struct; reject unknown formats with an error instead of silently returning empty/wrong data. Constraints: required whenever a ResourceSearchRequest's ResultFormat is changed/added, since requester and responder versions can skew during deploys; not needed for purely internal, single-process call paths with no version skew.
applies: Any code building/consuming resourcepb.ResourceSearchRequest/ResourceSearchResponse across the search service boundary
says: Search breaks when upgrading servers to different versions
Why does search return empty after changing format

search: Decode search responses based on response.GetResultFormat() itself, treating UNSPECIFIED as the legacy RESOURCE_TABLE default, not by the ResultFormat you requested. During rolling upgrades, when ResourceSearchRequest.ResultFormat changes (table to field values), old backend replicas still reply in the old format; callers assuming the response matches the requested format silently get nil/wrong data. The fix is to map both known formats into the same internal row struct and reject unknown formats with an error instead of returning empty/wrong data. This constraint is required whenever a ResourceSearchRequest's ResultFormat is changed/added, since requester and responder versions can skew during deploys. Not needed for internal single-process paths with no version skew; applies to code across the search service boundary building/consuming resourcepb.ResourceSearchRequest/ResourceSearchResponse (pkg/storage/unified/resource/list_with_selectors.go:decodeListSearchRows).
